context_notes: THE HEADLINE IS THAT EVERY REAL DEFECT THIS SESSION CAME FROM CHECKING EVIDENCE RATHER THAN VERDICTS, AND THE GATE WAS GREEN THE WHOLE TIME. check-rgr-routing.mjs reported 0 FAIL over eleven surfaces and nine corpus cases while the phase's own headline defect sat live in a shipped file -- lz-refactor/SKILL.md's intro routed behavior changes straight to lz-tpp, the exact dead end the phase exists to fix, in the first prose a model reads. Cause: every parsed surface anchors to a '## ' heading, so intro prose was outside all eleven; and descriptions were checked for character cap only, never content. THE MOST DURABLE OUTCOME IS THAT THIS BLIND SPOT IS NOW INSTRUMENTED AND MUTATION-PROVEN: restoring the original defect makes the checker fail with 'hops [lz-tpp] -- expected lz-red before lz-tpp', then goes green on a sha256-identical restore. What took three human-brief reviewers is now mechanical. SECOND, THE REVIEW THAT PAID BEST RAN EARLIEST: the plan-checker found two blockers inside the gap PLAN before any file was touched -- a placement instruction that would have broken build-variants.mjs's byte-exact C_POINTER anchor and taken the D-11 precondition RED (and would not have surfaced until a later task, after the earlier ones were committed, in a file the plan forbade editing), and an acceptance criterion that already passed at HEAD pre-edit because its phrase is line-wrapped. THIRD, THE NEGATIVE-CHECK TRAP FIRED FOUR TIMES IN FOUR DISGUISES and is the single most transferable lesson: a wrapped-phrase grep reading clean before any fix existed; 'rg -E' exiting 2 with no output while a '|| echo NONE' fallback reported absence; an rg piped into sort capturing sort's exit code; and a wrap-tolerant pattern whose \s+ sat at the wrong word join. Always check the exit code (0 hits / 1 genuine absence / 2 command failed) and run a positive control on the same path. FOURTH, WATCH THE DESCRIPTION HEADROOM: lz-red is now 1422 chars with 114 free under the 1536 cap -- 22-08 made it SHORTER, which was required, but the margin stays thin.
